coordinator.name: Argon
coordinator.role: Lead integrator in Gemini; excluded from subagent count
coordinator.invocation: Unverified. Discover the installed interface and actual concurrency limits before launch.
rules: Only the coordinator integrates worker branches and performs coordinated deployments.
Read the original checkout's local instructions before creating isolated worktrees; protected user changes are not transferable commits.
Consult the applicable source owner for changes outside a worker's listed paths; resolve unlisted ownership before editing.

concurrency: Use the actual platform limit in dependency waves; 24 planned roles do not mean 24 simultaneous writers.
workerBrief: You are not alone in the codebase. Do not revert other agents’ work. Edit only your owned paths; request integration changes from their owner.

releaseBoundary.providerPath: Cloudflare AI Gateway with owner's existing provider keys
releaseBoundary.newPaidServices: No unbounded provisioning, plan upgrade or budget increase; verify service support and use existing approved architecture.

existingArchitecture.retrieval: Versioned private S3 and S3 Vectors; bounded semantic plus deterministic matching; evaluate/pin OpenAI embeddings through Gateway.
existingArchitecture.mcp: Stateless Streamable HTTP on a separate portfolio MCP Lambda, API Gateway AWS_IAM and exact caller permissions; no public proxy path.
notes: No semantic index or application MCP server is implemented at capture.
Ordinary conversation may correctly skip retrieval/tools; the qualification scenario must exercise real tools intentionally.
No task is launched by this manifest.
